claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Spiperone is a high-affinity dopamine/serotonin receptor antagonist with no DNA-damaging or tubulin-directed activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to produce little or no cytotoxicity, and any antiproliferative signal would reflect non-specific pharmacology rather than a canonical cytotoxic mechanism.
